candidate_facts.candidate_value: Type 1 diabetes with hypoglycemia unawareness or significant glycemic lability.
candidate_facts.limitation: Registry inclusion criteria do not establish which eligible participants received treatment.

candidate_facts.candidate_value: Adults 18-65 years; T1D for at least 5 years; hypoglycemia unawareness or significant glycemic lability; stable diabetes treatment; willingness to use CGM; acceptable implant candidate. Excludes detectable stimulated C-peptide and other conditions.
candidate_facts.denominator_scope: Not an enrolled or treated count.
candidate_facts.endpoint_timing: CGM use is a screening/eligibility requirement.
candidate_facts.limitation: Human reviewer should confirm the exact criterion text and its version-specific scope.

candidate_facts.candidate_value: VC-02 combination product described as PEC-01 cells loaded into a delivery device.
candidate_facts.population_scope: Intervention is listed for Cohorts 1 and 2; Q3 extraction targets Cohort 2.
candidate_facts.limitation: Registry intervention description does not establish a participant-level treatment count.

candidate_facts.candidate_value: Cohort 2: up to 12 implanted units, up to 10 VC-02-300 implants and the remaining units VC-02-20.
candidate_facts.denominator_scope: Maximum planned units per participant, not the number of participants treated.
candidate_facts.limitation: Keep maximum planned device units separate from observed delivered dose.

candidate_facts.candidate_value: Interventional, non-randomized, sequential two-cohort design; no masking. The record describes Cohort 1 up to 15 and Cohort 2 up to an additional 60.
candidate_facts.population_scope: Whole study; Cohort 1 is safety context and Cohort 2 is target.
candidate_facts.denominator_scope: Planned cohort ceilings are not observed enrollment.
candidate_facts.limitation: No concurrent randomized comparator is listed.

candidate_facts.candidate_value: Registry distinguishes Cohort 2 efficacy C-peptide outcome from Cohort 1 safety outcome.
candidate_facts.locator: ClinicalTrials.gov history v20, protocolSection.outcomesModule and resultsSection.outcomeMeasuresModule.
candidate_facts.population_scope: Cohort 2 target; Cohort 1 safety is contextual only.
candidate_facts.limitation: Relationship to publication cohorts remains uncertain; do not change cohort-links.csv.

candidate_facts.candidate_value: C-peptide AUC 0-4 hours after mixed-meal tolerance test: mean change .1292, standard deviation .33157, unit ng*hour/mL, N=42.

candidate_facts.locator: ClinicalTrials.gov history v20, resultsSection.outcomeMeasuresModule.outcomeMeasures[Change in C-peptide for Cohort 2 Subjects].
candidate_facts.denominator_scope: 42 participants analyzed for this outcome; not 47 started.
candidate_facts.limitation: Retain source precision; surrogate result does not establish insulin independence, HbA1c, CGM, or severe-hypoglycemia outcomes.

candidate_facts.candidate_value: Cohort 2 safety data are reported separately from Cohort 1.
candidate_facts.limitation: Cohort-specific safety denominator is not an endpoint-efficacy denominator.

candidate_facts.limitation: Neither window is a nominal month-12/day-365/week-52 endpoint.

candidate_facts.candidate_value: Cohort 2: serious adverse events affected 19/47; other adverse events affected 47/47; deaths 0/47. Serious-event listing includes Hypoglycemia: 5 events in 2/47 participants, but source does not identify this term as the frozen severe-hypoglycemia endpoint. Frequency threshold is 2.

candidate_facts.denominator_scope: 47 at risk for Cohort 2 safety; 2 participants with serious-event term Hypoglycemia.
candidate_facts.limitation: No severe-hypoglycemia definition or event attribution to the target endpoint is established by this serious-event term.

candidate_facts.candidate_value: Cohort 1-only primary adverse-event endpoint: 33 total AEs in 2 participants, assessed from Enrollment (Visit 3, Day 1) through Month 4.

candidate_facts.population_scope: Cohort 1 safety context, not Q3 target Cohort 2.
candidate_facts.limitation: Must not be used as evidence for Cohort 2 outcomes.
